act_name: Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking (Repeal) Act, 2018 (Act No_XXVI of 2018)
heading: Short title and commencement
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement.— (1) This Act may be called the Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking (Repeal) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
